'''Kaminne Sihn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witch]] and chief of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]] as of [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], she led her Clan during its [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]] with [[Tasander Dest]]'s [[Broken Columns Clan]]. With the help of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Ben Skywalker]] and the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], as well as other off-worlders, the two clans fought off attacks by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] and successfully merged into one new clan, [[Bright Sun Clan]], headed by the newly [[Marriage/Legends|wedded]] Sihn and Dest. They then [[Attack on Bright Sun Hill|fought off]] the Nightsisters one final time.<ref name="Backlash" />
